title: Towards Training and Inference of Graph Neural Networks in Graph Databases
abstract: arXiv:2610.19142v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph Neural Networks on large graphs commonly rely on in-memory graph storage with ad hoc data processing pipelines for both training and inference. Graph databases provide scalable storage and efficient traversal for graphs that can evolve over time, but their applicability in GNN training and inference are rarely studied. We show that graph DBs can be used in GNN training and inference directly, executing sampling, feature retrieval, and even the full forward pass. We show different GNN training pipelines can perform on-the-fly sampling and retrieval in graph DBs using Cypher. We further provide optimisations that speed up the training process by \~2.5x while maintaining the same accuracy. We illustrate that fully in-DB inference is possible, independent of how the GNNs are trained. translated_title: 图数据库中图神经网络训练与推理的探索
translated_abstract: 大规模图上的图神经网络在训练和推理时通常依赖于内存中的图存储以及临时搭建的数据处理流水线。图数据库为可随时间演化的图提供了可扩展的存储和高效的遍历能力，但其在图神经网络训练和推理中的适用性却很少被研究。我们证明图数据库可以直接用于图神经网络的训练和推理，执行采样、特征检索，甚至完整的前向传播。我们展示了不同的图神经网络训练流水线可以使用 Cypher 在图数据库中进行即时采样和检索。我们进一步提供了若干优化方法，在保持相同精度的同时将训练过程加速约 2.5 倍。我们证明了完全在数据库内进行推理是可行的，且与图神经网络的训练方式无关。在真实世界的图数据上，我们的推理设置比将图冷加载到内存中快 10 倍以上，且没有额外的内存开销。我们的工作为图数据库中图神经网络的训练与推理奠定了基础。
tldr: 该论文证明图数据库可以直接用于图神经网络的训练与推理，通过 Cypher 实现即时采样与特征检索，并提供优化使训练加速约 2.5 倍、数据库内推理比冷加载快 10 倍以上且无额外内存开销。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that graph databases can directly support GNN training and inference by performing sampling, feature retrieval, and even full forward passes via Cypher, with optimizations achieving ~2.5x training speedup and in-DB inference over 10x faster than cold loading with no extra memory overhead.
